title: The Biggest Black Hole Ever Found

scenes.voiceover: This is the biggest black hole we have ever found. And it should not exist.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: colossal black hole with blazing accretion disk

scenes.voiceover: TON six eighteen weighs as much as sixty six billion suns.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: scale comparison of star vs monster black hole

scenes.voiceover: Its event horizon is so large, light itself needs weeks just to cross its shadow.
scenes.mainText: light needs WEEKS to cross it
scenes.visualConcept: photon crawling across a vast black rim
scenes.backgroundPrompt: light beam dwarfed by black hole shadow

scenes.voiceover: Our entire solar system, out to Pluto, could fall inside it thousands of times over.
scenes.mainText: our solar system fits THOUSANDS of times
scenes.backgroundPrompt: solar system as a speck beside black hole

scenes.voiceover: And as it feeds, it burns brighter than one hundred trillion stars combined.
scenes.visualConcept: dark frame igniting into quasar glare
scenes.backgroundPrompt: quasar jets blazing across intergalactic space

scenes.voiceover: The problem? The universe may not be old enough to grow a black hole this large.
scenes.mainText: the universe may not be old enough to grow it

scenes.voiceover: Somewhere out there, it is still feeding. Follow mindwired for the universe's biggest mysteries.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: distant quasar glow in deep darkness
